_about: Every file in Dependencies/ that ships with TiXL, who uses it and under which licence. Installer/check-licences.py fails when a file is missing here or its licence is not allowed. builtInCi marks files a release build produces itself, so they are absent in a checkout. Licence texts live in licenses/. installerAdditions lists what the release scripts bundle outside NuGet and Dependencies/; check-licences.py --notices writes all of it into THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt.
